name: pluslife-analyzer
description: macOS app for the Pluslife molecular test system. Wraps the virus.sucks web app in an Electron shell that keeps the Mac awake (caffeinate), auto-reconnects to the last Bluetooth device, remembers the last test type, and launches in one click.
author: Jason R. Coombs <jaraco@jaraco.com>

extendInfo.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Pluslife Analyzer connects to your Pluslife test dock over Bluetooth to run tests.
extendInfo.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Pluslife Analyzer connects to your Pluslife test dock over Bluetooth to run tests.
